decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1/ The failure to provide a one metre setback, from the main frontage of the house at first floor level would, ensure that the proposed first floor flank extension, due to its its size, position and appearance  in relation to  neighbouring residential properties,  be unduly obtrusive and detrimental to the visual amenities of adjoining occupiers and create a terracing effect.   The proposal  is contrary to the Policies ENVB 1.1 (New Development)   and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance, Residential Extension Guidelines.     
2/ The proposed first floor rear extension would, by reason of its size, scale and position have a dominant and oppressive effect resulting in overshadowing, loss of outlook and would therefore be detrimental to the amenities of neighbouring properties, contrary Policies ENVB 1.1 (New Development)   and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance, Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Demolition of existing garage and the erection of a two storey side and rear extension to existing dwellinghouse.
